title: Letter 30
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 30

paragraphs.text: {{BIBLE:mat 7:7}} to receive the 'three loaves' of the Trinity, {{BIBLE:luk 11:5}} and, when the Lord goes before us, to walk upon the water of the world.</quote> {{BIBLE:mat 14:25}} Written at Rome A.D. 384.
